Welcome to the OpenSea digest. Here is a look back through the biggest NFT and web3 news of the week.


## Art Blocks Marfa Weekend kicks off next week in West Texas


[Art Blocks](https://www.artblocks.io/) , an OpenSea partner, will host its 6th annual[Marfa Weekend](https://www.artblocks.io/marfa-weekend) Oct. 22 to 25 in Marfa, Texas.


On Saturday morning, the Chinati Foundation and Art Blocks will host a sunrise viewing of Donald Judd's 15 untitled works in concrete. Later that morning, a panel at the Crowley Theater centered on ABX, Art Blocks' onchain publishing stack, will look at what it means to publish work that outlives a platform. Panelists include Ryley of Art Blocks, artist dadabots and Han Saglam (hanrgb), moderated by Art Blocks founder Erick Calderon.


The Artist Fair continues Saturday at Saint George Hall, followed by Art Blocks' annual backyard cookout. The weekend closes with a farewell breakfast on Sunday. You can view the schedule[here](https://www.artblocks.io/marfa-weekend-2026-schedule) .


> One week from today. Join us at the Art Blocks Marfa Weekend Opening Party: Taking place at One Fourteen, recently rebuilt by Stephen McKeon @sbmckeon for the event! co-hosted with longtime partner @opensea 🤝 https://t.co/o9Ht9BwIG6
>
>
> — Art Blocks (@artblocks_io)[October 15, 2026](https://x.com/artblocks_io/status/2110733942609387776?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)


## Ledger unveils Atom, a phone-style device with a separate Secure Mode


Hardware wallet maker[Ledger](https://www.ledger.com/) unveiled Ledger[Atom](https://www.ledger.com/blog-introducing-ledger-atom) at its Ledger Op3n event in Paris on Oct. 15, with Chairman and CEO Pascal Gauthier presenting the device, according to[Ledger's post on X](https://x.com/Ledger/status/2110796679855452270) . Ledger describes Atom as its first device with everyday apps and 5G connectivity built in. It switches to Secure Mode whenever a user interacts with their private keys.


Atom runs Android alongside Ledger OS, and transactions are reviewed and signed in Secure Mode, separate from everyday apps,[The Block reported](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-15-ledger-atom-solana-mobile-418644) . A limited Founders Edition costs $849, with a $100 refundable deposit to reserve one, and deliveries are expected to begin in summer 2027, pending certification.[Solana Mobile](https://solanamobile.com/)[said](https://x.com/solanamobile/status/2110708917701603431) its Seeker app is also coming to Atom. Ledger said app availability depends on certifications and licenses and will be confirmed before devices ship.


The launch follows Ledger's investigation into hardware wallets fitted with an unauthorized implant and sold through a reseller in Southeast Asia. Ledger asked resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales while it investigates,[Decrypt reported](https://decrypt.co/380940/ledger-asks-resellers-in-seven-asian-markets-to-pull-devices-after-suspected-86m-drain) . Onchain researchers have traced more than $86 million in suspected losses, a figure Ledger says it has not verified. Ledger told[CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/10/15/under-pressure-ledger-unveils-plan-to-turn-its-crypto-hardware-wallet-into-a-smartphone) that Atom includes tamper-detection protections designed to block this type of implant, and that it will initially sell the device only through its own website.


> Relive the moment @_pgauthier, Chairman & CEO, revealed Ledger Atom™ at Ledger Op3n in Paris: the device built to protect everything you value. Our first device with your everyday apps and 5G connectivity built in, switching to Secure Mode whenever you interact with your private keys.
>

## Mastercard and BVNK launch a platform for holding fiat and stablecoins side by side


[Mastercard](https://www.mastercard.com/) and[BVNK](https://www.bvnk.com/) , a[stablecoin](https://opensea.io/learn/token/what-is-a-stablecoin) infrastructure company Mastercard acquired in August, launched the Global Money Platform on Oct. 15, according to a[press release](https://www.mastercard.com/us/en/news-and-trends/press/2026/october/mastercard-and-bvnk-launch-global-money-platform-to-power-a-mult.html) . It is the first major integration of Mastercard and BVNK capabilities since the acquisition.


The platform lets banks, fintechs and enterprises embed multi-currency accounts where fiat and stablecoins sit together, with conversion between them handled through a single API. Users will be able to spend stablecoin balances across Mastercard's merchant network and send local-currency payouts through Mastercard Move. Payments firm Nuvei and card-issuing platform Marqeta are among the first companies to integrate the platform.


Mastercard said the platform will add future support for agentic commerce and tokenized deposits. The Global Money Platform is available now through BVNK.


> Today we’re launching Global Money Platform – connecting BVNK’s stablecoin engine to @Mastercard's global payments capabilities. Banks, fintechs and enterprises can now offer stablecoin payments, local payouts, stablecoin-linked cards, and multi-currency accounts through a single integration. Watch how it works 👇
>
>
> — BVNK (@BVNKFinance)[October 15, 2026](https://x.com/BVNKFinance/status/2110678269695512876?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)


## Blur to retire its website and stop new Blend loans on Nov. 12


[Blur](https://blur.io/) , an NFT marketplace on Ethereum, said its blur.io frontend will be deprecated on Nov. 12, according to an[announcement on X](https://x.com/blur_io/status/2109735810857861203) . Blur said the change applies only to the website. The Blur marketplace protocol will remain operational onchain, and $BLUR will continue to control its fee switch.


Blend, Blur's NFT lending platform, will stop matching new loans on the same date. Borrowers have until then to repay their loans or allow them to default, and Blur said it will provide a frontend tool afterward to help users withdraw their assets from Blend.


Blur also warned users to watch for impersonators and fraudulent announcements, noting that its only official account is[@blur_io](https://x.com/blur_io) .


> 1/ The https://t.co/zPQ1jqR7pT frontend will be deprecated on November 12, 2026. This deprecation only applies to the frontend. The Blur marketplace protocol will remain operational on-chain, and $BLUR will continue to control its fee switch.

## NODE opens NODE Studio NYC


[NODE](https://nodefoundation.com/) , a nonprofit foundation focused on digital art, has opened its second location, NODE Studio NYC, according to an[announcement on X](https://x.com/nodefnd/status/2109743505044279529) . NODE said the studio serves as a bridge to its main exhibition space in Palo Alto and is designed as a multidisciplinary workspace to explore new ideas.


NODE Studio NYC is currently open to visitors by appointment only, with broader availability planned for 2027. Visits can be scheduled through NODE's website or by emailing nyc@nodefoundation.com.


> It’s official: our second NODE has joined the network. Serving as a bridge to our main exhibition space in Palo Alto, NODE Studio NYC is designed as a multidisciplinary workspace to explore new ideas. Thank you to everyone who joined us to celebrate. NETWORK MAKES ART WORK https://t.co/fOPQmhbTbF
>
>
> — NODE (@nodefnd)[October 12, 2026](https://x.com/nodefnd/status/2109743505044279529?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)
